privacyMeet: If you request an intro meeting through the chat, Gerwin receives your name, email address, organization and message by email. He uses them only to get in touch with you, at your request.
privacyCookies: This site sets two functional cookies: lang for the language and theme for the display. They are set on your first visit, change when you use the switches at the top, and are kept for a year. They hold no ID and are used for nothing else. Page views are counted without cookies.
privacyRights: Conversations are kept on the basis of legitimate interest: Gerwin reads them to improve the chat. You have the right to access, correct and delete your data, to restrict or object to its processing, and to data portability. Email Gerwin and mention the conversation ID below, so he can find your conversation. You can also lodge a complaint with the Dutch Data Protection Authority (Autoriteit Persoonsgegevens).
